command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "== step: generate host keys if missing =="
sudo -n ssh-keygen -A
ls -la /etc/ssh/*.pub

echo "== step: create CA key =="
sudo -n mkdir -p /etc/ssh/ca
sudo -n ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -f /etc/ssh/ca/ssh_ca -N "" -C "ssh-user-ca-node1"
sudo -n chmod 600 /etc/ssh/ca/ssh_ca
sudo -n chmod 644 /etc/ssh/ca/ssh_ca.pub

echo "== step: sign the ed25519 host key with CA =="
sudo -n ssh-keygen -s /etc/ssh/ca/ssh_ca -I "node1-host-cert" -h -n "node1,$NODE_IP,$NODE_NAME" -V +3650d /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key.pub
ls -la /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key-cert.pub
sudo -n chmod 644 /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key-cert.pub

echo "== step: verify cert content =="
ssh-keygen -L -f /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key-cert.pub

echo "== step: configure sshd to present certificate =="
printf 'HostCertificate /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key-cert.pub\n' | sudo -n tee /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/99-host-cert.conf
sudo -n sshd -t
echo "sshd config OK"

echo "== step: enable and start ssh =="
sudo -n systemctl enable --now ssh
sudo -n systemctl is-active ssh
